title: Fallen Angel Cathedral
description: A surreal gothic cathedral interior features a large central female face with closed eyes, geometric red and yellow markings, and four large white feathered wings. Below are smaller winged faces, skeletal hands cupping a glowing green smiley face orb, and a pile of detached green smiley heads and bones. The decaying walls are covered in graffiti, with a blood-red eclipsed moon and floating smiley orbs dripping red liquid from a shattered rose window above.
prompt: A surreal dark artwork inside a decaying gothic cathedral with broken stained glass rose window. A large central female face with closed eyes, black tears, red and yellow geometric markings, and four large white feathered wings adorned with ivy. Smaller grotesque winged faces float below. Skeletal hands hold a glowing green smiley orb above a pile of green smiley face heads, bones and skulls. The stone walls are covered in colorful graffiti including smiley faces. A blood red eclipsed moon and floating red smiley orbs drip blood from above in a nightmarish scene.
